newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's May electrical output falls 1.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's May electrical output falls 1.4 percent.

text.p: Peru's electrical power output in May fell 1.4 percent compared with the same month last year, to 1,366 gigawatt hours (GWh), the Energy and Mines Ministry said Tuesday.
Electrical power output in the first five months of the year was up 2.0 percent from a year earlier, to 6,881 gigawatt hours (GWh).
Public service firms accounted for 1,169 GWh in May, while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 197 GWh of the country's output.
State-run Electroperu, the largest of Peru's power-generating public service firms, produced 477 GWh in May, down 10 percent from May 1996.
